First public release of AeroGallery, a local Windows photo gallery inspired by Frutiger Aero.

- Browse folders with persistent SQLite indexing, virtualized thumbnails and a Rust image engine.
- View full-resolution pictures, zoom, pan, rotate and play slideshows.
- Choose Aero, Aqua, Aurora or Frost, with live tint, opacity and reflection controls.
- Open supported pictures from Explorer, drag and drop files or folders, copy images and set wallpapers.
- Check for new stable releases from the application.

Download the Windows x64 NSIS setup executable below. The installer is not code-signed; Windows may display a SmartScreen warning. Some native desktop interactions (including Snap Layouts, clipboard interoperability and mixed-DPI behavior) have not received interactive acceptance testing.
